fact: Loi n°24.001 on personal data protection, promulgated 25 January 2024, gives a right to know and contest automated processing behind decisions with legal effect, provides for a data-protection agency with powers to warn, order cessation and fine, and gives the ministry twelve months to set the agency up, performing its tasks meanwhile.
title: Loi n°24.001 portant protection des données à caractère personnel
